import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD1 = 998244353;
    static final int MOD2 = 1000000007;
    static final int N = 2000000;
    static final int MX = 1000000;
    static long n, c;
    static int tot, ans, lim;
    static int[] pw = new int[9];
    static int[] sum = new int[7];
    static List<Integer>[] ve = new ArrayList[7];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            ve[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static int dec(int x, int y, int mod) {
        return (x - y < 0) ? x - y + mod : x - y;
    }

    static int add(int x, int y, int mod) {
        return (x + y >= mod) ? x + y - mod : x + y;
    }

    static void dfs(int pos, long now) {
        if (now <= n) {
            tot++;
            int x = dec(tot, (int) now, MOD1);
            ve[pos - 1].add(x);
            sum[pos - 1] = add(sum[pos - 1], x, MOD2);
        }
        if (pos > 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs(pos + 1, now * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static void solve(int pos, long now) {
        if (now > n) return;
        if (pos > 1) {
            if (10L * now * MX > n && (1L * (now + 1) * MX - 1) <= n) {
                for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
                    int x = (int) (((long) (c - 1L * now * pw[i]) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1);
                    int p = lowerBound(ve[i], MOD1 - x);
                    ans = add(ans, add((int) ((1L * x * ve[i].size()) % MOD2 + sum[i]) % MOD2, MOD2 - (int) ((1L * MOD1 * (ve[i].size() - p)) % MOD2), MOD2), MOD2);
                }
                c += tot;
                return;
            }
            c++;
            ans = add(ans, (int) (((c - now) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1), MOD2);
        }
        int start = (pos == 1) ? 1 : 0;
        for (int i = start; i <= 9; i++) {
            solve(pos + 1, now * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= target) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        pw[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 9; i++) {
            pw[i] = 10 * pw[i - 1];
        }
        tot = 0;
        ans = 0;
        c = 1;
        Arrays.fill(sum, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            ve[i].clear();
        }
        dfs(1, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            Collections.sort(ve[i]);
        }
        solve(1, 0);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
